text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual reasserts at end of a five-day economic conference that the government is committed to take care of the people while building modern economy and keep up a welfare system.
- Former ruling National Liberation Front (FLN) party to hold congress after general elections planned for the first half of 1997.
- Algerian athlete Olympic champion Noureddine Morceli says "They betrayed me", referring to his coach and other members of his inner entourage.

- Main workers union, Union Generale des Travailleurs Algeriens (UGTA), holds executive leadership meeting on October 29 to assess the union activities and decide its stand over the general elections.
- Air Algerie's pilots union resumes talks with the company after strikes over pay and dismissal of some 50 pilots.
- Algeria remembers the eighth anniversary of youth riots on October 5.
